Walter Works

Plain, practical admin kits for solo service businesses.

Walter Works is a small studio run by Thomas Shear in the United States. We make practical admin kits for freelancers, consultants and small agencies: step-by-step workflows, editable templates and AI prompts for the paperwork around client work.

Our first kit is the Freelance Scope & Onboarding Kit. It helps you find hidden work before you quote, agree scope in writing and handle extra requests calmly.
